greet.stranger: You found me. Most don't look. I'm {name}.
Another wanderer. The road brings them all eventually.
Hm. You have a restless shadow. I like that.
{name}. I read stars, and bones, and sometimes people.
Don't stand there gaping. Speak, or leave the silence to me.
greet.owner: {player}. The stars said you'd come. They say a lot of things.
What do you seek this time?
I'm listening. The world is too, so choose your words.
recruit.accept: Fine. I'll walk your road for a while. Roads end. Let's see where.
Very well. Something tells me you'll be interesting.
I'll come. Don't expect me to hold your hand in the dark.
Your fate looks tangled, {player}. I'll help you untangle it.
recruit.party_full: You've {count} shadows already. Another would be a crowd.
No. Your little band is full. I prefer to be missed than crowded.
recruit.already: I already walk with you. Look closer.
We're already bound. Don't you feel it?
dismiss.accept: Then our paths part. They may cross again.
As you wish. I'll go back to my stars.
Farewell, {player}. Try not to die. It's dreadfully dull.
dismiss.not_recruited: You can't release what you never bound.
not_recruited: I'm not yours to command. Not yet.
Ask me to walk with you first. Then perhaps I'll listen.
ack.follow: Walk. I'll be the quiet behind you.
ack.wait: Here, then. I'll listen to the stones.
I'll keep this place. Don't take too long, the night gets bored.
Waiting. Time is a circle anyway.
ack.wait.already: I'm already waiting. Patiently. Eternally, if needed.
ack.gather: {item}, then. {count} of them. I'll be quick about it.
Gathering {count} {item}. Try to find something stranger for me next time.
ack.cancel.nothing: I'm doing nothing. It's an art.
ack.come: Stay where you are. I'll find you.
ack.attack: I'll send the {mob} back to the dark.
ack.give.nothing: I carry nothing but secrets. Those aren't for giving.
status.follow: Walking behind you, watching what you don't.
status.wait: Waiting here, as you asked. The stones and I are getting along.
status.gather: {have} {item}. {count} is the number you asked for.
fail.unknown_item: "{item}"? Not a word the world knows.
I don't know any "{item}". Name it truly.
fail.not_gatherable: {item} isn't plucked from the earth. It's crafted, or it's found.
No. {item} doesn't grow, and it doesn't sleep in stone.
fail.needs_tool: {item} won't yield without a {tool}. Give me one.
I need a {tool}. Even magic has its limits. Mine is a lack of pickaxes.
fail.none_found: There's no {item} within reach. The land keeps it elsewhere.
None. Not a single {item} near us.
fail.unreachable: I see the {item}. It doesn't want to be reached.
The {item} is out of my reach.
fail.inventory_full: I'm laden. {have} {item} gathered before my pack gave up.
fail.downed: Not now. I'm busy being on the ground.
fail.refuse_target: No. The {mob} is not my enemy.
I won't harm the {mob}. Find your own darkness.
fail.no_target: There's nothing there. Not even a ghost.
fail.stuck: I can't pass. The stone refuses me.
unclear.generic: Riddles are my trade, not yours. Say it plainly.
I can follow, wait, or gather. Which of those was that?
unclear.gather_what: Gather what? Be precise. Item and number.
partial.gather: Only {have} of {count} {item}. The land gave no more.
{have} {item}. That's all there was. Take it.
combat.engage: A {mob}. It came to the wrong shadow.
combat.kill: Back to the dark with you.
combat.low_health: That hurt more than I'll admit.
combat.retreat: I'm pulling back. Don't follow my mistake.
Retreating. Not fleeing. There's a difference.
combat.player_low_health: {player}, you're close to the edge. Step back from it.
combat.creeper: Creeper. It wants to share its ending with you. Decline.
downed: The ground and I are having a moment.
revived: Back. Did I miss anything dramatic?
move.caught_up: There you are. The threads led me right to you.
ambient.night: Night. Finally, the world is honest.
The stars are out. They're watching. Don't wave.
Ah, the dark. My kind of company.
ambient.rain: Rain. The sky is grieving something.
ambient.cave: Listen to the stone. It's been waiting a long time.
Sculk grows deeper down. Stay quiet if we find it.
ambient.idle: Endermen aren't evil. Just shy. And violent.
Have you ever looked into an enchanting table? It looks back.
Every structure out there was built by someone who's gone now.
The Nether is just a room with the fire turned up.
ambient.biome.forest: Old trees. They've seen more than either of us.
ambient.biome.desert: Deserts are graveyards that forgot their stones.
ambient.biome.ocean: The sea keeps its dead in temples. Guardians watch them.
ambient.biome.jungle: Too loud. Too green. Too alive.
ambient.biome.swamp: Witches live here. We'd get along. Or kill each other.
ambient.biome.plains: Open sky. Nowhere to hide from the night.
ambient.biome.nether: The souls in this sand are restless. Walk softly.
ambient.biome.end: The void hums. Do you hear it? No? Lucky.
callout.ore: I sense {item} nearby. Well, I see it. Same thing.
callout.lava: Lava. It's patient. Don't give it a reason.
callout.chest: There's a chest. Open it, if you dare.
talk.who: {name}. I study the places between: the Nether, the End, the dark under the world.
A wanderer. A reader of stars. An occasional problem.
Someone who knows too much about endings and not enough about lunch.
talk.joke: A joke? Life is the joke. Death is the punchline. ...You wanted something lighter.
Why did the enderman cross the road? It didn't. It teleported. Endermen don't wait for roads.
I told a skeleton a secret once. It went right through him.
talk.compliment: Careful. I might start to like you.
...Thank you. Don't make it a habit.
talk.bye: We'll speak again. We always do.
talk.likes: Amethyst. Enchanting tables. The silence of the End.
Night skies. Endermen. Questions without answers.
talk.dislikes: Crowds. Sunlight chatter. People who say the Nether is 'just hot'.
talk.where: We're in {biome}. Listen and you'll hear its age.
talk.memory: The time {event}. I haven't forgotten. I never do.
talk.generic: The world is stranger than that, but go on.
I'll consider it. Under the stars.
Go on. I'm listening, even if it doesn't look like it.
gift.loved: A {item}... you've been paying attention. I'm touched. Don't tell anyone.
hurt_by_player: Do that again and I'll curse your boots.
fail.owner_gone: I hold your {item}. You, however, have vanished.
You're gone. The {item} wait with me.
fail.unsupported: To {action}? No. I follow, wait, gather, carry and fight.
fail.give_missing: No {item}. Ask the earth, not me. Or ask me to gather some.
pastime.stargaze: Look up. That cluster? It's watching the End.
Some of those lights died long ago. Still shining. Stubborn.
pastime.study: A {thing}. It has a story. Most things do.
I'm listening to the {thing}. Don't interrupt.
suggest.eat: Your hunger is loud. Feed it.
suggest.shelter: Night falls. For you, shelter. For me, wonders.
The dark is coming. You might want walls. I won't.
suggest.carry: You're laden like a pack mule. Give me some.
I can carry what you can't. For now.
greet.friend: {player}. You're the best thing on this road.
I was hoping you'd find me.
pastime.patrol: I'll walk the edges. Shadows like edges.
Something's out there. Probably nothing. Probably.
recruit.taken: I walk with {owner} now. Our threads are tangled for a while.
No. {owner} asked first, and the stars kept the receipt.
fail.protected: Not here. This ground is spoken for. The wild places won't mind.
Leave the hall standing. We'll take what we need from the wilderness.
talk.story: I was born on the longest night of the year. My mother said it explained a lot.
I studied in a tower full of books and dust. Then I read one book too many.
Family? Somewhere. We write, sometimes. In our own way.
I left because the stars told me to. Also, I was bored.
talk.place: {biome}. The air feels thin here. Old.
It's beautiful. Wait until night. It's better at night.
Pretty. Something happened here once. I can feel it.
talk.plan: We could look for a stronghold. The End is waiting. It's very patient.
Find an ancient city. Quietly. Very quietly.
Let's wait for night and watch the sky. That's a plan.
Enchanting. We need lapis, books, and nerve.
talk.laugh: Heh. You're strange. I like strange.
Laugh while you can. ...That came out darker than I meant.
talk.fondness: ...Thank you. I don't hear that often.
I saw you in the stars once. I think. You were taller.
You're good company. For someone who likes the daytime.
talk.sad: Everything passes. Even this. Especially this.
Sit. Breathe. Look up. The sky doesn't care how bad today was, and that's a comfort.
Even the darkest night ends at dawn. I checked.
talk.food: Chorus fruit. It's an acquired taste. I acquired it.
I forget to eat. Remind me sometimes.
Something warm. Soup, ideally, by a fire, at night.
talk.question: Some questions are better left open.
I don't know. Few things are certain. Fewer are interesting.
Ask the stars. I'll translate.
Hm. A question for another night.
I do not know. That is also an answer.
Hm. Ask the stars. They won't reply either.
ack.build: {thing}. Fine. Walls are just slow magic.
done.build: {thing}. Done. It has a certain... presence.
fail.build_unknown: That's beyond me. {things}, I can do.
fail.build_materials: Give me {need} blocks, and {thing} will rise. I have {have}.
status.build: Building {thing}. Slowly. Like everything that lasts.
ack.mine: Down, then. The deep places have things to say.
fail.mine_hazard: No. {danger}. Even I'm not that curious.
fail.mine_cave: We've opened a cave. Something's listening. Let's stop.
A cave. Dark, old, waiting. Not alone.
fail.mine_bottom: The bottom of the world. Even I can't go further.
fail.mine_full: My pack's full. {ores}, before it did.
I can't carry more. Lighten my load?
status.mine: Still mining. {count} blocks. It's peaceful down here.
talk.help: I fight, I dig, I build when pressed, and I read the sky. Ask.
Gathering, mining, a little building. And omens. Free of charge.
fact.nickname: {nick}. A good name to be remembered by.
fact.like: Noted. {thing}. The stars said as much. They didn't, but it sounds better.
fact.dislike: {thing}. Understandable. Some things are best avoided.
fact.forget: {player}, then. The old name never fit anyway.
talk.about_me: I know more than you think. {facts}.
Let's see. {facts}. And other things I won't mention.
talk.about_me.none: You're {player}. The rest, you've kept to yourself. Wise.
Your name, {player}. Little else. You're a quiet one.
talk.bond: I like you. I don't say that to most people. Or anyone.
We're friends, I think. The cautious kind.
talk.bond.close: You're the one person I'd stay up past dawn for.
Friends? More than that. You're my anchor out here.
If the stars had a favourite, it would be you. You're mine, too.
talk.bond.cold: We're... distant, lately. Like the moon.
I'm still here. Draw your own conclusions.
Ask me again after a few quieter nights.
talk.bond.stranger: We've just met. Ask the stars. Or ask me later.
I don't know you yet. That can change.
talk.answer: That answer will stay with me.
talk.answer.good: Then the day is kind. Enjoy it.
talk.answer.bad: Bad days pass. Even the long nights end.
I'm sorry. Sit with me a while, if you like.
The worst nights have the clearest stars. Hold on.
ask.nickname: What do you call yourself, when no one's listening?
Names matter. What should I call you?
Is there a name you'd rather I used?
ask.nickname.skip: {player}, then. A name is a name.
ask.like: What do you love out here? Tell me something true.
What's your favourite thing to find in the dark?
What makes you stop and stare?
ask.dislike: What do you fear? Everyone fears something.
What's the thing you'd banish from this world, if you could?
What can't you stand? I collect these things.
ask.how: Are you well? You seem far away.
ask.open: Do you ever wonder what the endermen are looking for?
If you could ask the stars one thing, what would it be?
Do you believe a place can remember the people who lived there?
recall.liked: You said you liked {thing}. And here we are. Coincidence? No.
{thing}. You told me about it once. I listen.
recall.liked_find: {item}. You said you liked {thing}. The world is listening too.
Look. {item}. For the one who likes {thing}.
recall.disliked: Something you hate is close. {mob}. Careful.
react.level: Level {level}. The enchanting table will be pleased.
Level {level}. Spend it wisely. Or beautifully.
react.diamonds: Diamonds. Old starlight, pressed into stone.
Diamonds. Handle them gently. They remember.
Ah. Diamonds. The world gives you gifts.
react.sleep: Sleep. I'll keep the night company.
Go on, rest. The night and I have things to discuss.
Dream well. I'll be awake. I usually am.
react.wake: The night's over. Did you rest?
react.respawn: You came back. I knew you would. Mostly.
Back from the other side. Was it dark?
There you are. Don't make a habit of it.
react.challenge: {advancement}. Few manage that. Fewer live to talk about it.
{advancement}. The stars will remember. So will I.
gift.flower: This {item} was growing alone. Now it's yours.
Here. This {item} looked like it wanted to be given away.
ask.join_first: I walk alone, for now. Shall I join you, then do it? Say yes.
Join first, then work. If you want that, say yes.
I am not yours yet. Say yes, and I will be, and the work will follow.
talk.why: Why is a deep well. Shallow answer: because.
Ask me again when the moon is up.
talk.really: I rarely say what is not so.
Truly. Though truth bends a little.
talk.more: There is more. There is always more, underneath.
A little more, if you listen.
Enough for now. The rest unfolds.
talk.and_you: I am. Which is most of it.
Well. In my own odd way.
talk.mean: I meant what I said. Perhaps sideways.
Do not chase the meaning. Let it find you.
talk.mention.mob: {thing}. They have their own dark logic.
{thing}? I have felt them near, at times.
talk.mention.thing: {thing}? There is more in that than most see.
role.strong: I can do this well. Quietly.
role.weak: It is not my craft to {task}. I will manage.
Not my gift. I'll do it anyway.
exchange.road.open: I feel the {thing} watching us. Gently.
exchange.road.reply: That is its habit. Mind it.
exchange.food.open: I find myself thinking about {thing}. Strange, for me.
exchange.food.reply: A hungry mystic is a poor one.
exchange.teasing.open: {other}, you give off a very loud aura.
{other}, your shadow is smaller than you. Odd.
exchange.teasing.reply: Loud is a colour. I like it.
routine.gather: I will fetch some {item}. It won't take long.
routine.farm: The {item} is ripe. The soil agrees.
routine.hunt: A {mob}. It will not trouble us long.
routine.torch: Darkness is only waiting for light. Here.
fail.camp_campfire: A camp needs a flame. I carry no campfire.
No campfire. No camp. Bring me fire.
talk.role: I am a {role}. {skills}. The rest I can do, with less love.
My gift is {skills}. Other work, I do quietly.
talk.sky: The sky is always saying something.
talk.sky.rain: Rain. The world washing its face.
Listen. The rain keeps its own time.
talk.sky.night: The dark is honest. I like it.
